title: Processing Frozen Cells for Population-Scale SQK-LSK114 Oxford Nanopore DNA Sequencing
author: Jackson Mingle

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Apex 96 Plates
steps.instruction: Set up the following deep-well plates for the KingFisher Apex 96:

substeps.instruction: Plate 1 (Lysis/Binding): Add 50 µL resuspended cells, 20 µL Proteinase K, 5 µL Buffer CLE3, and 20 µL RNase A per well in that specific order.
Plate 2 (Nanobind Storage): Place one 3 mm Nanobind disk at the bottom of each well.
Plate 3 (Wash 1): 700 µL Buffer CW1 per well.
Plate 4 (Wash 2): 700 µL Buffer CW2 per well.
Plate 5 (Wash 3): 700 µL Buffer CW2 per well.
Plate 6 (Elution): 100 µL Buffer EB per well.
Plate 7 (Tip Plate): KingFisher Apex 96 deep-well tip comb.
Prepare Buffer CW1 and CW2 by adding 96–100% ethanol to reach a 60% final ethanol concentration as indicated on the bottles.

steps.title: Prepare Frozen Cell Pellets
steps.instruction: Process frozen cell pellets for extraction:

substeps.instruction: Obtain frozen cell pellet from -80 °C freezer and thaw on ice for 5 minutes.
Input amount: 1x10^6 – 2.5x10^6 diploid human cells (or 5-25 µg DNA for non-human/non-diploid cells).
Add 50 µL of 1X PBS to each pellet and pipette-mix 10x with a P200 pipette until fully resuspended without lumps.
Ensure instrument has 96 deep-well magnetic head and heating block.
Select 'Cell_Nanobind_HT_APEX' script and load plates as prompted.
Add 150 µL Buffer BL3 gently against the side of the well into the Lysis/Binding solution.
When prompted (~21 minutes after start), remove Lysis/Binding Plate and gently add 250 µL isopropanol to each well against the side wall, then resume.
When prompted, remove Elution Plate and transfer eluate (including residual from tip comb plate) to 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tubes.

steps.title: Solubilize and Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare and check the extracted DNA:

substeps.instruction: Let eluate rest overnight at room temperature.
Pipette-mix 10x with a P200 pipette.
Quantify using Qubit Flex Fluorometer (Qubit 1x dsDNA BR Assay) using 2 µL of DNA per measurement.
Optional: Size on Agilent Femto Pulse (Genomic DNA 165 kb kit); expected size >100kb.
Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Shear DNA with Megaruptor 3
steps.instruction: Shear DNA to target size (N50 ~25-35 kb):

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNA in 100 µL Buffer EB at a concentration ≤ 150 ng/µL in a Megaruptor 3 shearing tube.
Prepare the Megaruptor 3 DNA Fluid+ shearing syringe: tighten assembly, compress plunger, and attach to tube.
Load samples and run at speed 45 for a total of 2 runs. Enter accurate sample volume (100 µL) and concentration.
Remove samples and syringe, ensuring the plunger is fully depressed to avoid volume loss.
Quantify sheared DNA using Qubit Flex (Qubit 1x dsDNA BR Assay) with 1 µL of DNA.
Optional: Size on Agilent Femto Pulse (Genomic DNA 165 kb kit); expected size ~25-40 kb.
Store at 4 °C (or -80 °C for long-term).

steps.title: Size Select DNA via BluePippin
steps.instruction: Perform size selection to target ~24-40 kb:

substeps.instruction: Prepare up to 10.5 µg sheared DNA in 77 µL TE buffer or Buffer EB (or 32/62 µL for low volume).
Add 11 µL 2X Loading Solution (or 10/20 µL 1X Loading Solution for 32/62 µL samples) to DNA; mix and spin down.
Calibrate BluePippin optical sensors (Target I pH, mA = 0.60) within 30 minutes of run.
Set 'BP Start' to 10000 (or 15000/20000 for specific markers).
Prepare cassette: remove adhesive strips, insert into nest, dislodge air bubbles, and inspect for delamination.
Perform Continuity Test; if failed, refill elution module.
Seal elution modules with tape, remove all buffer with P100 pipette, then add 80 µL fresh electrophoresis buffer slowly.
Remove 85 µL buffer from sample wells (or 40/80 µL for 32/62 µL samples) and load 85 µL sample (or 40/80 µL).
Load 40 µL DNA marker into the marker well.
Run the system and wait 30-45 minutes after completion before removing samples (~80 µL) using a P200 pipette.
Quantify final mass using Qubit Flex (Qubit 1x dsDNA BR Assay) with 1 µL of DNA. Minimum 2.5 µg required for library prep.
Optional: Size on Agilent Femto Pulse; expected size ~24-40 kb, DQN > 9.8.

steps.title: Library Preparation (Manual or Automated)
steps.instruction: Prepare the SQK-LSK114 library. (Note: Protocol provides both manual and Hamilton NGS STAR automated paths).

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNA: 2.5 µg DNA in 48 µL nuclease-free water.

DNA Repair and End-Prep: Incubate at 20 °C for 30 min, then 65 °C for 5 min. Add 12 µL DNA repair enzyme master mix (NEBNext FFPE Repair Buffer, Ultra II End-Prep Buffer, FFPE Repair Mix, and Ultra II End-Prep Enzyme Mix). Incubate 20 min at 37 °C and 450 rpm.
Clean-up 1: Use AMPure XP beads and Short Fragment Buffer. Wash with 80% ethanol, dry for 30s, and elute with 26 µL Elution Buffer.
Adapter Ligation: Add 40 µL ligation enzyme master mix (Ligation Buffer, Quick T4 DNA Ligase, Ligation Adapter). Incubate 3 min at 37 °C and 450 rpm.
Clean-up 2: Use AMPure XP beads. Wash with 80% ethanol, dry for 30s, and elute. Quantify with Qubit 1X dsDNA HS Assay.
Final Library: Store at 4 °C (or -80 °C). Minimum 750 ng required for loading.

steps.title: PromethION Flow Cell Loading and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Load the library and initiate the 72-96 hour sequencing run:

substeps.instruction: Prepare 300 ng DNA library in 32 µL Elution Buffer.
Prepare Priming Mix (1170 µL Flow Cell Flush + 30 µL Flow Cell Tether) and Wash Mix (398 µL Wash Diluent + 2 µL Wash Mix).
Equilibrate flow cell at room temperature for 20 min; check for >6500 pores.
Prime flow cell: Load 500 µL priming mix twice, drawing back 20-30 µL to remove bubbles.
Load 200 µL of library (mixed by pipetting 5x) into the inlet port.
Perform wash: Load 400 µL wash mix, draw back bubbles, and remove waste buffer via waste port 2 or 3.
Initiate MinKNOW: Select SQK-LSK114-XL kit, fast basecalling, raw reads .POD5, min Q score 8, and 72 or 96 hour run time.
Monitor pore occupancy in the first hour; perform pore scans or re-insert flow cell if issues occur.
